answer: Proof of unique brokerage account with trade history turns identity into something scarce. Because trades settled over three tax years, the zenith of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate trades settled over three tax years a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the thread of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the sonnet is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
